title: What Scripture Actually Means by Walking Humbly at Work
caption:
Walking humbly doesn't mean staying quiet.

It's the guy who can take correction without needing the room back. Who lets the idea that actually helps the team win, even when it wasn't his. Who does the job that will never show up in a review, because humility isn't a mood you perform in a meeting. It's doing the unwatched work anyway.

You don't have to defend your name in every conversation. You don't have to win the credit back.

"Humble yourselves, therefore, under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time." (1 Peter 5:6)

He's already keeping it.
